newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia leaves internal coffee price unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Colombia leaves internal coffee price unchanged.

text.p: Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation said Friday it was leaving the country's internal coffee price at 431,375 pesos per 125-load until further notice.

The internal price has been raised 14 times, and cut just twice since the Jan. 31 introduction of a new sliding-scale formula to calculate payments to Colombian growers and allow the domestic price to track the sharp run-up in local prices.
But the federation, which has been setting new prices every Friday since Jan. 31, said no further price moves would be announced until a weekly policy meeting next Tuesday.

Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo has said he favors using at least part of the windfall from higher international coffee prices to shore up the finances of the National Coffee Fund, instead of passing all the profit on to growers.

The fund guarantees purchases of all Colombian coffee, at support prices in times of low world market prices, and finances everything from scientific research to key infrastructure projects in the country's central coffee-growing region.
